fields.summary: Weight normalisation and unknown-unit rejection for supplier imports
fields.description:
As a catalogue manager I want supplier weights normalised and rows with unknown units rejected so that catalogue data stays consistent.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Weights supplied in lb or g are converted to kilograms, rounded to 3 decimals.
2. Rows with a unit that is not in the attribute dictionary are rejected with error code UNIT_UNKNOWN and are not imported.
3. Imported products are assigned an ETIM class based on the supplier category column.
